short: Orbit gain after subtracting capped contributions

lean.name: Formalism.MainNotions.G.gU
lean.plain: Orbit gain after subtracting capped contributions
lean.note: On a single orbit, $g_U$ starts at $\gamma_p$ times the sum of the reduced top weights. It subtracts the capacity-limited terms at odd positions and an orbit error, leaving the full geometric-series contribution at even positions before that error.
